title: Domain Modules vs. Function Wrappers — Check

questions.explanation: Functions are thin HTTP wrappers; domain logic and policies live in lib so they can be tested and reused independent of the deployment host.
options: Parsing the HTTP request and formatting the HTTP response
The mapping of soil types to crop coefficients
The retry policy for the CIMIS upstream

questions.prompt: Keeping logic in `lib/` lets the same gateway module be driven by both the local mock server and the production Netlify function.
questions.explanation: Because the logic does not depend on the HTTP host, multiple wrappers (mock server, Netlify function) can drive the same module.

questions.prompt: How does this layering relate to inversion of control?
questions.explanation: The logic is independent and the wrapper depends on it — control of the dependency direction is inverted toward the stable core.
options: The deployment host controls the domain logic's internals
The domain logic depends on Netlify-specific APIs
The deployment wrapper depends on the logic, not the reverse
Tests must run inside the Netlify runtime
